name: Molting Feather
text: Before bidding, you may remove a chosen card from your hand.
archetypes: Discard Dominance; splash Spade Master, Nil Champion
family: Voids, singletons, and long suits / Shedding
decision: Which card to shed before bidding: a singleton to open a void for trumping and throwing off, or a high card that would break a nil.
opponent: The removal is shown, but not the card.
aiNote: Remove the card whose loss best fits your plan (on nil your most dangerous, otherwise a card that leaves a useful void), or keep the hand when every removal hurts.
rationale: Removing one card opens a void about a third of the time (any singleton) and makes nils much safer, at the cost of one card to win with. It feeds Empty Basket, Scouring Tornado, and every throw-off payoff without adding a counter.
deviation: Redesigned from a payoff for emptying suits in the first six tricks, which was complicated for little reward.
